thig13.2:1.1: samaṇā ti bhoti maṃ vipassi samaṇā ti paṭibujjhasi | samaṇānam eva kittesi samaṇī nūna bhavissasi. || ||
thig13.2:2.1: vipulaṃ annañ ca pānañ ca samaṇānaṃ pavecchasi | Rohiṇi dāni pucchāmi kena te samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:3.1: akammakāmā alasā paradattopajīvino | āsaṃsukā sādukāmā kena te samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:4.1: cirassaṃ vata man tāta samaṇānaṃ paripucchasi | tesaṃ te kittayissāmi paññāsīlaparakkamaṃ. || ||
thig13.2:5.1: kammakāmā analasā kammaseṭṭhassa kārakā | rāgaṃ dosaṃ pajahanti tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:6.1: tīṇi pāpassa mūlāni dhunanti sucikārino | sabbapāpaṃ pahīn' esaṃ tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:7.1: kāyakammaṃ suci nesaṃ vacīkammañ ca tādisaṃ | manokammaṃ suci nesaṃ tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:8.1: vimalā saṃkhamuttā 'va suddhā santarabāhirā | puṇṇā sukkāna dhammānaṃ tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:9.1: bahussutā dhammaddharā ariyā dhammajīvino | atthaṃ dhammañ ca desenti tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:10.1: bahussutā dhammaddharā ariyā dhammajīvino | ekaggacittā satimanto tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:11.1: dūraṅgamā satimanto mantabhāṇī anuddhatā | dukkhass' antaṃ pajānanti tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:12.1: yamhā gāmā pakkamanti na vilokenti kiñcanaṃ | anapekkhā' va gacchanti tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:13.1: na te saṃ koṭṭhe osenti na kumbhiṃ na kaḷopiyaṃ | pariniṭṭhitam esānā tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:14.1: na te hiraññaṃ gaṇhanti na suvaṇṇaṃ na rūpiyaṃ | paccuppannena yāpenti tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:15.1: nānākulā pabbajitā nānājanapadehi ca | aññamaññaṃ piyāyanti tena me samaṇā piyā. || ||
thig13.2:16.1: atthāya vata no bhoti kule jātā si Rohiṇi | saddhā buddhe ca dhamme ca saṅghe ca tibbagāravā. || ||
thig13.2:17.1: tuvaṃ h' etaṃ pajānāsi puññakkhettaṃ anuttaraṃ | amhaṃ pi ete samaṇā paṭigaṇhanti dakkhiṇaṃ |
thig13.2:18.1: paṭiṭṭhito h' ettha yañño vipulo no bhavissati. || || sace bhāyasi dukkhassa sace te dukkham appiyaṃ |
thig13.2:19.1: upehi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ saṅghañ ca tādinaṃ | samādiyāhi sīlāni tan te atthāya hehiti. || ||
thig13.2:20.1: upemi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ saṅghañ ca tādinaṃ | samādiyāmi sīlāni taṃ me atthāya hehiti. || ||
thig13.2:21.1: brahmabandhu pure āsiṃ so idāni 'mhi brāhmaṇo | tevijjo sotthiyo c' amhi vedagū c' amhi nhātako. || ||
